title: COA in Boston
description: Archived information about onsite Certified OpenStack Administrator exams at the Boston 2017 Summit, including historical exam times and registration details.
body:
Become a Certified OpenStack Administrator by taking the COA exam onsite at the Boston Summit!

The Certified OpenStack Administrator exam is the only OpenStack exam offered by the OpenStack Foundation, and is a vendor-neutral, skills-based assessment of OpenStack user fundamentals. You can read more about the COA at openstack.org/coa. Sign up to take the COA onsite at the Boston Summit by selecting “COA Onsite Exam” during your Eventbrite checkout. Within two business days of purchase, you will be emailed a registration code and directions for selecting a timeslot.

The COA exam will be offered the following times*:

  • Wednesday, May 10, 9am-12pm ET
  • Wednesday, May 10, 1:30pm-4:30pm ET

*Exam purchase does not guarantee a particular timeslot. Timeslots will be filled on a first come, first served basis. Above timeslots are updated daily but are not a real time reflection of availability.

All COA onsite test takers must have a Full Access Badge to the OpenStack Summit Boston. Test registrants without a Summit badge will not be admitted to the exam and will not receive a refund for their exam.

Regrettably, at this time we are not able to transfer previously purchased online tests to the onsite option, nor transfer onsite tests to the online option after purchase.

COA Onsite refund policy: Refunds will be granted up to three days after purchase until May 6, at which point only refunds will only be granted for unscheduled exams within 24 hours of purchase.
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
